verdict.rationale: Unleash's release management provides built-in background automation: rollouts can progress through milestones automatically while monitoring application health, and safeguards can pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold. Change requests can also be scheduled, but that is a one-off timed action rather than a recurring automation. The automation is limited to flag rollout progression, not general user-defined autonomous workflows; missing for 10: general-purpose or recurring automations beyond rollout progression, documentation of agent-driven background execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: you can define a reusable, structured rollout process that progresses automatically while monitoring application health
Automate milestone progression or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold.
